note: Hand-written stand-in support tickets for Larkspur Supply Co., not real customers. intent is the answer under the guideline; decoy, where set, is the plausible misreading make-labels.mjs gives a labeller who slips; gold tickets were checked by the support lead. The first 90 are the labelling pool; the last 30 are held out to test the triage model.

guideline.refund: Money back, and nothing has to come back to us.
guideline.return: The customer still has the item and it comes back to us, for a swap or for their money.
guideline.delivery: Where an order is, or when and how it arrives.
guideline.product: What an item does, fits or costs, or when it is in stock.
guideline.account: Logins, details, invoices and trade account settings.
